horizon_rationale: 20 adjacent 100ms observations each side balances immediate interaction context and boundary censoring; 1/3s show sensitivity. Diagnostic only, not a response-time or Formal P2 threshold.
bin_rationale: Descriptive bins include every observation and unbounded upper tails; density width reuses existing state-support convention. No bin is an acceptance criterion.
control_policy: Within dataset and region: same mapped lane, independent 30s block, 5mps speed stratum; nearest speed then time then identity; different follower, without replacement; evaluable nonrisk state outside all official event intervals plus/minus 3s for that follower. Unmatched remains Unknown.

bootstrap.unit: observed follower trajectory within each separate dataset/region
bootstrap.purpose: descriptive source-window cluster variability only; not independent-day or simulator-seed uncertainty

common_support_policy: Report all macro cells and their population weights; shared cell comparisons describe support, never align clocks or reweight the official populations.

contracts.simulation: SUMO formal-aligned diagnostic and D1 remain distinct; common point diagnostics are not a new formal measurement contract
